hook.name: useVideoController
hook.description: Reads local camera state and exposes camera, mirroring, hardware acceleration, and virtual background actions.
hook.returns: VideoController with videoState, capability flags, and asynchronous video actions. See types for every returned field.
notes: canControlVideo is true when the Video SDK client has a media stream. It does not check the connection state. To match VideoButton, enable controls only when canControlVideo is true and useZoomUIToolkit().sessionState.connectionState === ConnectionState.Connected.

When canControlVideo is false, toggleVideo, startVideo, stopVideo, setHardwareAcceleration, and switchCamera while video is on do nothing. setMirrored and setVirtualBackground still update videoState, which startVideo uses. Any connection state change resets the background choice to the default (see vbImageId).
canUseVirtualBackground is true when the SDK supports virtual backgrounds and its model is ready.
videoState reflects the current local camera status.
startVideo uses the selected camera, mirroring preference, HD video, and the selected virtual background when canUseVirtualBackground is true.
switchCamera has no effect while disconnected. When video is off, it selects the camera for the next start.
setVirtualBackground accepts an ID from videoState.virtualBackgroundImageList. Invalid IDs produce an operation warning.

Actions never reject. Failures of start, stop, camera switch, mirroring, hardware acceleration, and background actions appear in videoState.warning. If starting video fails, an error notification is also shown.
If a hardware acceleration change isn't applied, nothing changes and no warning is set. Check hardwareAccelerationSending and hardwareAccelerationReceiving afterward.

types.name: VideoController
types.description: Local camera status, available features, and actions returned by useVideoController.

fields.name: videoState
fields.description: Current local camera status and settings.

fields.name: canControlVideo
fields.description: True when the Video SDK client has a media stream. Does not check the connection state.

fields.name: canUseVirtualBackground
fields.description: Whether virtual backgrounds are supported and ready to use.

fields.name: toggleVideo
fields.description: Starts or stops video based on videoState.isVideoOn.

fields.name: startVideo
fields.description: Starts the selected camera with the current mirroring and virtual background settings. Failures appear in videoState.warning, and an error notification is also shown.

fields.name: stopVideo
fields.description: Stops the local camera. Failures appear in videoState.warning.

fields.name: switchCamera
fields.description: Switches to the camera with this device ID (from useZoomUIToolkit().deviceState.cameras). When video is off, selects the camera for the next start. Preserves the mirroring preference. Does nothing unless the session is connected. While a switch is in progress, deviceState.isSwitchingCamera is true.

fields.name: setMirrored
fields.description: Mirrors or unmirrors the local preview. Failures appear in videoState.warning. Without a media stream, the choice is saved for the next startVideo.

fields.name: setHardwareAcceleration
fields.description: Turns hardware acceleration on or off. encode controls sending video; decode controls receiving video. An omitted option leaves its videoState value unchanged. If the change isn't applied, nothing changes and no warning is set.

fields.name: setVirtualBackground
fields.description: Selects a background by ID from videoState.virtualBackgroundImageList. Invalid IDs leave the selection unchanged and set videoState.warning. Without a media stream, only vbImageId is updated; startVideo applies it unless a connection state change resets it first.

types.name: VideoState
types.description: Current local camera status, settings, and virtual background readiness.

fields.name: isVideoOn
fields.description: True when the local camera is active for the current user. Updated only while VideoButton, the SettingsPanel Video tab, or a component that calls useVideoController is mounted.

fields.name: vbImageId
fields.description: Selected background ID: '' for none, 'blur', or one of your image IDs. It returns to sessionOptions.video.virtualBackground.defaultVirtualBackgroundImageId when the connection state changes or when you pass a new sessionOptions object, so keep sessionOptions stable (for example with useMemo).

fields.name: virtualBackgroundImageList
fields.description: Available background choices: the built-in None (id '') and Blur (id 'blur') entries, followed by the valid custom images from sessionOptions. The built-in entries' names are English only and their url is not an image, so show your own translated labels and no thumbnail for them.

fields.name: isVirtualBackgroundReady
fields.description: Whether the Video SDK virtual background model is ready. Before offering virtual backgrounds, also check useVideoController().canUseVirtualBackground.

fields.name: isMirrored
fields.description: Whether the local camera preview is mirrored. Defaults to true and resets to true if the session reconnects or ends.

fields.name: hardwareAccelerationReceiving
fields.description: Whether hardware acceleration is enabled for receiving video (decoding). Starts false and turns true automatically once it can be enabled. useVideoController().setHardwareAcceleration also changes it. Resets if the session reconnects or ends.

fields.name: hardwareAccelerationSending
fields.description: Whether hardware acceleration is enabled for sending video (encoding). Starts false and turns true automatically once it can be enabled. useVideoController().setHardwareAcceleration also changes it. Resets if the session reconnects or ends.

fields.name: isLoading
fields.description: True while video is starting or stopping. For camera switches, use useZoomUIToolkit().deviceState.isSwitchingCamera.

fields.name: warning
fields.description: Latest video error, such as a camera, mirroring, or virtual background failure, or null when there is no error.

types.name: MediaWarning
types.description: An audio or video error, such as denied permission or a failed operation.

fields.name: type
fields.description: 'permission' when microphone or camera access is denied, 'operation' when an action fails. 'unknown' is reserved and not currently produced.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Details about the failure, when available. It may be a Video SDK error code or reason (for example 'INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES') rather than a user-facing sentence, so show your own text based on `type`.

types.name: VirtualBackgroundImage
types.description: A virtual background choice. Use this shape for images you pass in `sessionOptions.video.virtualBackground.virtualBackgroundImageList`. `videoState.virtualBackgroundImageList` also starts with the built-in None (id '', url '') and Blur (id 'blur', url 'blur') choices, whose names are English only.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique image ID. The values '' and 'blur' are reserved for no background and blur. If an ID is reserved or repeated, only the first entry with that ID is kept.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Non-empty accessible label for the image. Supply a translated label for your application. Entries with empty names are ignored.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Non-empty image URL. Entries with empty URLs are ignored.
